instructions: Should {name} reply to the latest message?
criteria_true: Yes: the message is something {name} would naturally respond to — it names {name}, continues work {name} is doing, assigns the current step to {name}, or is a request that nobody has taken yet and {name} is able to handle.
criteria_false: No: the message is aimed at another member, {name}'s part comes later, or {name} has nothing to add.
